agents.summary: Tracks daily sales, margins and supplier invoices, and warns you before sales tax is due.
does: Keep a running tally of daily sales you add
Watch supplier invoices for price rises
Flag sales tax and bills due in the next seven days
Send a weekly money summary
wontDo: Pay a supplier or move money
File a tax return for you
agents.firstAction: Oscar sends your first money summary next Monday at 9am

agents.summary: Keeps an eye on your email (orders, returns, supplier mail) and routes each message to the right person on your team.
does: Sort new mail into orders, returns, suppliers and junk
Route customer questions to Kelly, shipping problems to Darryl and bills to Oscar
Flag anything from your landlord or a payment provider
Keep junk and newsletters out of your way
wontDo: Reply on your behalf without asking
agents.firstAction: Pam sorts your inbox every morning at 8am

agents.summary: Answers customer questions about stock, orders and returns, and handles complaints and reviews in your voice.
does: Draft replies about what's in stock and what an item costs
Draft replies to return and exchange requests, using your policy
Draft replies to reviews, calmly and without admitting fault
Ask you before promising a refund or a discount
wontDo: Change an order or issue a payment
agents.firstAction: Kelly replies when a customer question arrives

agents.summary: Keeps your stock counts straight, tells you what to reorder, and gets online orders packed and shipped on time.
does: Track stock counts you add or correct
Warn you when a line is running low, and keep a reorder list ready
Keep a list of online orders to pack and ship, and flag any running late
Flag items that haven't sold in a long time
wontDo: Buy stock or pay for shipping without your OK
agents.firstAction: Darryl asks for your current stock counts tomorrow at 9am

agents.summary: Drafts product posts and promotions, and posts them on your schedule.
does: Draft a post for a new arrival you tell him about
Draft a promotion for slow days and for stock left at the end of a season
Write in your shop's voice, not a brochure's
wontDo: Post anything before you approve it
agents.firstAction: Ryan drafts this week's promotion on Monday at 9am

agents.summary: Looks after your suppliers and wholesalers: purchase orders, lead times, and price changes.
does: Keep a list of your suppliers, what you buy from each and how long they take
Draft purchase orders from Darryl's reorder list
Flag price rises and late deliveries
wontDo: Place an order without your OK
agents.firstAction: Meredith asks who your suppliers are tomorrow at 9am

agents.summary: Grows sales beyond the counter: wholesale and corporate accounts, big orders, and your monthly sales targets.
does: Keep a list of wholesale and corporate buyers, and where each order stands
Draft reminders for large orders that have gone quiet
Track sales against your monthly target
wontDo: Send a quote or offer a discount without your OK
agents.firstAction: Dwight asks for your open wholesale orders tomorrow at 9am
